title: Voice assistant orb with status card tour
summary: On a bright grid canvas a tiny call glyph grows into an app icon, a brand moment plays on a soft gradient, then a glossy orb speaks in typed lines and three rim-lit cards land one by one while the camera follows the newest.
use_when: Launching a voice or chat agent that does a few concrete jobs for the user
Showing three capabilities as live status cards rather than screen recordings
A calm, light, premium tone with no music or VO required
A 20 to 25 s explainer where the assistant itself is the character

look.type_style: rounded geometric grotesk; brand word semibold white 6 % H; assistant lines regular sentence case 3 % H; card headings bold navy 4 % H; tiny mono timers

sfx.event: call glyph pops in on the grid
light sweep across the end line

structure.shot: empty white canvas with a faint grid; a tiny round call-glyph button pops in at centre and holds
structure.camera: grid lines shift between cells, slow pull-out, scale not measurable (±0.25 s)
structure.motion: button springs.pop scale 0 to 1 at 0.27 to 0.50 s (overshoot not measurable), ~10 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: button has grown into a large squircle icon with a blue-lavender-peach mesh fill; glyph crossfades call to waveform; bars dance
structure.motion: grow 12 to 110 px on easings.pillGrow 12 fr (±0.25 s); glyph crossfade 8 fr (±0.25 s); waveform bars loop easings.linear

structure.shot: icon washes to white, frame floods with a blurred blue-violet gradient; brand word fades in white at centre
structure.motion: wash tint + fade 8 fr, gradient resolves 8 fr; word opacity 0 to 1 over 8 fr (±0.25 s), easings.outQuint

structure.shot: a caret appears left of the word and deletes it right to left until only the caret remains
structure.motion: typewriter delete at ~2 chars per 0.25 s, easings.stepped per char, letters fade 2 to 3 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the caret thickens into a rounded bar, then a white app-icon squircle with the brand mark; holds, then washes out to white
structure.motion: caret to bar to squircle on springs.ui ~12 fr (±0.25 s); mark fades in 8 fr; wash out 8 fr

structure.shot: glossy pastel orb fades in on white left of centre; a short greeting, 1 word, is wiped in beside it
structure.motion: orb opacity 0 to 1 in 8 fr, scale 0.96 to 1, ~100 px leftward drift decelerating over 20 fr (easings.outQuint); greeting mask-wipe right to left + 30 px slide, 9 fr

structure.shot: greeting shrinks up and greys; a second line, 7 words, types under it with a soft fading tail; then both fade, orb alone
structure.motion: greeting moves up on springs.ui 12 fr (±0.25 s); line types ~1.1 chars/fr with an 8 to 10 char opacity tail; text fades 8 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: orb slides off right; a huge pale rounded card lands from the camera and settles at left with a light-blue rim glow
structure.motion: orb exit 120 px right + fade 10 fr, easings.inExpo; card scale ~2.5 to 1 and blur heavy to 0 on easings.landing over ~18 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: card one: bold heading, 1 word, types in; three call rows appear one by one with mini orb, live bars, timer and call button
structure.motion: heading typewriter 1 char/fr, starts 3 fr after row 1; rows stagger 6 to 8 fr, each fades 5 to 6 fr with 4 px blur, no slide

structure.shot: card two rises from lower right with a calendar strip, three appointment rows and a confirmed pill; camera moves onto it
structure.camera: push-in 1.00 to 1.25 over 25 fr with pan right, easings.inOutSine
structure.motion: card rise 12 fr from opacity 0.1, scale 0.85, +60 px, blue tint to white, springs.ui; rows stagger 6 to 8 fr; pill pops springs.pop (overshoot not measurable)

structure.shot: everything tints pale blue and dissolves; card three resolves: reminder timeline on the left, message bubble panel on the right
structure.camera: static, then dolly left starts at 17.75
structure.motion: wash tint 8 fr, card resolves out of the tint 8 fr (±0.25 s); timeline steps and bubbles fade in staggered ~6 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: card slides off left; orb returns at right; a short line, 3 words, fades in left of it then clears
structure.camera: dolly left ~530 px/s at 1920 for ~0.5 s, easings.inOutSine
structure.motion: orb enters from right, springs.heavy (no overshoot), ~24 fr (±0.25 s); line fades 8 fr in and out

structure.shot: a new line, 6 words, types left of the orb with a soft fading tail and holds
structure.motion: soft-tail typing ~1.1 chars/fr, 8 to 10 char opacity ramp; hold ~0.75 s

structure.shot: orb exits right while the line crossfades into a centred close, 4 words, ending in the product name; a light sweep crosses the letters; hold
structure.motion: crossfade 8 fr (±0.25 s); sweep left to right ~1 s at 21.75 to 22.75, easings.inOutSine; hold to 23.50; fade out 8 fr

params.seedGlyph: NotifGlyph kind for the seed button (call by default)
params.lineA: assistant line after the greeting, up to 8 words
params.cards: 3 capability cards: title (1 word) + rows; card 1 call rows, card 2 schedule rows + confirmed pill, card 3 timeline + message
params.bookend: two short assistant lines before the close, 3 and 6 words
params.close: end line, 4 words, ending in the product name

notes: Zero cuts in 24.53 s: every change is a morph, wash, landing card or camera move. Measured from the human notes: orb in 8 fr, orb out 10 fr, card rows stagger 6 to 8 fr, heading types 1 char/fr, card rise 12 fr, follow push 1.25 over 25 fr, wash 8 + 8 fr. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Proposed terms: wash, soft-tail-type, card-land, shimmer-sweep, caret-morph.
